title: Copy it right here
story: On your laptop you're already in the folder where you keep this project's figures. Copy scores.csv from ~/{{project}} on Geiss-01 into the folder you're in. A single dot means "here".

tasks.text: Copy scores.csv into the laptop folder you're in

hints: Use the Laptop tab. `.` as the destination means the folder you're in.
In the Laptop tab run `scp student@geiss-01:~/{{project}}/scores.csv .` and then `ls`.
